# The texture of a moving shadow filled through the alpha mask
# Made by tools/oracle on 2026-10-20 from runblack.exe size 8663040 sha256 3f58bc02a6c421b4e66ef08716646bf0e1fa55ab292786edb521d7596ed48aba
# Matrix rows x, y, z axes then the place; the light is straight above the place.
# Mask place i holds ((i * 37 + (i >> 6) * 11) & 15) << 4.
# Texels by rows, two 16-bit texels to a word, the first in the low half.
